statement: For m+p odd, the real Wronski map Gr(m,R^(m+p))→RP^(mp) has topological degree up to sign I(m,p), the absolute sign imbalance of standard tableaux of rectangular shape m^p (equivalently ballot sequences on p symbols, each occurring m times). Thus it is surjective and every regular real fibre has at least I(m,p) real points. The sign imbalance is |Σ_T (−1)^inv(T)|, with the row-word inversion convention of equation (11).
